title: KPIs
description: Department figures: name, unit, rhythm and the value of each period.
newDescription: Saved as a draft; it appears under “KPIs” once it is published.
emptyHint: Create the first one, for example “Cubic metres loaded”.

aggregations.last: Latest value (for example a stock level)

name.label: Name
name.hint: For example “Cubic metres loaded” or “Workshop orders completed”.

unit.label: Unit
unit.hint: For example “m³”, “items” or “orders”. May stay empty.

description.label: Description
description.hint: One sentence on what is counted. Shown below the KPI.

department.label: Department
department.hint: That department's head maintains the KPI too.

period.label: Rhythm
period.hint: The period each value stands for.
period.locked: Can only change while no values are entered.
period.invalid: The rhythm can only change while no values are entered.

aggregation.label: Year figure
aggregation.hint: Sum: the year's values add up. Latest value: the most recent level counts.

values.hint: Empty means not reported yet. Comma or point as the decimal separator, no thousands separators.
values.hidden: {count, plural, one {One earlier value is kept.} other {# earlier values are kept.}}
values.invalid: Please enter numbers only, for example 1250.5.
